dhp363:2: _Manta_ can refer to sacred recitations (“mantras”), however the more common meaning is “advice, counsel.” _Anuddhata_ can also mean “not agitated” - so this line could be rendered “who is not agitated when giving advice.”
dhp368:3: _Pada_ can also mean “location,” in which case this could be rendered “arrives at the place of peace” or simply “reaches peace.”
